items.title: Bloom Energy (BE) Signed A Carbon Captured Power Deal In California
items.summary: Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE) signed a memorandum of understanding with California Resources Corporation to pursue large carbon-captured power projects in California. The partnership targets gigawatt scale development of solid oxide fuel cell power generation paired with carbon capture and storage across the state.
